title: Layer 5 pyramidal neurons couple the state and contents of consciousness

statements.text: Layer 5 pyramidal neurons receive input from and send output to both thalamus and cortex, so the thalamo-cortical and cortico-cortical loops meet in them. That coupling of the two loops is the neural counterpart of the coupling of the state and the contents of consciousness.

sources.quote: both the state and the contents of consciousness depend on the activity of cortical layer 5 pyramidal (L5p) neurons
couple these two loops in a unique way, hence functionally coupling the state and contents of consciousness
